## Century steps through time

The models no longer use century steps (see the lake-periods in the report). These figures show the
steps between consecutive sampled centuries for description only.

```{r}
show_figure('report/figures/supplementary/fig_tracking_transition_rates.pdf')
show_figure('report/figures/supplementary/fig_tracking_transition_ratios_angles.pdf')
```

**Lake-level transition rates, tracking ratios and angles** under the regional climate eras, with
the Anthropocene plots as boxplots.
